meta_description: LAW Plastering in Manchester delivers expert plastering, skimming, and rendering. Quality finish, fast turnaround, free quotes available.
hero_eyebrow: Expert Plasterers — Quality Finishes Every Time
hero_subhead: From fresh skims to textured finishes, we deliver flawless plasterwork on time and on budget across Greater Manchester.
services_subhead: We handle everything from minor repairs to large-scale refurbishment work, with meticulous attention to finish.

services.title: Skimming & Re-plastering
services.desc: Tired walls? We skim over old plasterwork to give you a smooth, professional finish ready for decoration. Perfect for modernising tired interiors.

services.title: Textured Finishes
services.desc: Artex removal, Tyrolean, or bespoke textured coatings. We create the exact look you want with hard-wearing, quality finishes.

services.title: Rendering & External Work
services.desc: Weatherproof your property with professional external rendering. We use quality materials and proven techniques to protect your home for years.

services.title: Drywall & Partition Installation
services.desc: Create new rooms or reconfigure spaces. We install, tape, and finish drywall to building standards, ready for painting.

services.title: Ceiling Work
services.desc: Cracked or sagging ceilings? We repair, replace, and finish ceilings to a flawless standard — no drips, no compromise.

services.title: Damage & Repair
services.desc: Water damage, cracks, or holes? We make quick, invisible repairs that blend seamlessly with your existing plasterwork.

about_pullquote: We take pride in leaving every room looking perfect, not just passable.
about_para_1: LAW Plastering was founded on a simple principle: do the job right, first time, and treat every home like it's your own. Based in Harpurhey, we've spent nearly two decades perfecting our craft across Manchester and the surrounding areas. Our reputation is built on consistent quality, reliability, and honest pricing—no hidden costs, no cutting corners.
about_para_2: Homeowners and contractors alike return to us because they know exactly what they'll get: meticulous workmanship, clear communication, and a finish that lasts. We turn up on time, leave the site clean, and stand behind every job we do. Whether you need a simple skim or a full rewire with new plasterwork, we bring the same professionalism and care.
reviews_heading: What Manchester Homeowners Say About LAW Plastering

reviews.text: Had the whole lounge skimmed by LAW Plastering. Absolutely brilliant job, wall is perfectly smooth now. Came when they said they would, worked cleanly, and the finish is flawless. Wouldn't hesitate to book them again.
reviews.author: David T.

reviews.text: Sorted out a nasty water-damaged patch on our bedroom ceiling. They made it disappear completely—you can't even tell where the damage was. Professional, friendly, and fair price. Highly recommended.
reviews.author: Claire M.

reviews.text: Been using LAW for years on rental properties. Always reliable, always on time, and the workmanship is spot on. They take pride in what they do. That's why they're our go-to plasterers.
reviews.author: Marcus J.
